items.title: M8: capability_release_backfill CLI (dry-run/apply/--digest) + live B-785e/PBP-882 backfill
items.context: Mirror playbook_seed_backfill. Default --dryRun detects under-bound candidates (lineage lacks capabilityReleaseId while a capability release exists for the story); --apply enriches exactly those with capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion/artifactReleaseId; a --digest confirm gate (apply requires the dry-run plan digest). Idempotent, never activates, never infers helped. Then RUN it on the real B-785e artifact release + PBP-882. Ref: exec-plan doc M8 + Follow-up Story.
items.userSees: capability_release_backfill --dryRun: 1 eligible (B-785e/PBP-882); --apply: PBP-882 enriched with capabilityReleaseId; re-run: 0 eligible (idempotent)

happy.desc: capability_release_backfill --dryRun detects under-bound candidates (lineage lacks capabilityReleaseId while a capability release exists for the story); --apply enriches exactly those with capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion/artifactReleaseId. Live-run against real B-785e/PBP-882 binds PBP-882.

edge.desc: --apply requires a --digest matching the dry-run plan; re-running apply is idempotent (0 eligible, no duplicate candidate); a story with no capability release yields 0 eligible.

adversarial.desc: Backfill never activates a candidate (status stays candidate), never infers a helped outcome, and never mutates the capability-releases ledger authority/gateEvidence.

items.title: M6: candidate pending-learning exposure surfaces + exposure records
items.context: Render candidate capability playbooks ONLY under pendingLearning / promotionRecommendations / candidate-inspection, never as active runtime guidance (matchActivePlaybook status===active guard already enforces this; do not weaken it). Write an exposure record per exposure: playbookId, capabilityReleaseId, exposureMode, surface, storyId or sessionId, observedAt.
items.userSees: playbook_promotion_status shows PBP-882 with capabilityRelease after backfill; an exposure record is written on candidate-inspection exposure

happy.desc: A capability candidate (post-backfill PBP-882) surfaces in playbook_promotion_status pendingLearning with its capabilityRelease lineage; when exposed via candidate-inspection an exposure record is written (playbookId, capabilityReleaseId, exposureMode, surface, storyId/sessionId, observedAt).

edge.desc: Exposure only under pendingLearning/promotionRecommendations/candidate-inspection; the candidate never enters active runtime surfacing (matchActivePlaybook status guard, unchanged).

adversarial.desc: Writing an exposure record does not change the candidate status and is not treated as a helped outcome.

items.title: M7: structured-outcome recording + evidence-based promotion recommendation commands
items.context: Command surface to record a structured outcome (helped/dismissed/harmful) bound to a concrete exposureMode + structured verdictSource, and a command to emit promotion recommendations when decisiveSamples suffice. DONE-success != helped and the decisiveSamples exclusions are already enforced in learning-store.ts (B-8128 asserts); build the user-facing commands on top without changing those rules.
items.userSees: playbook_outcome_record accepts a structured capability-candidate outcome; playbook_promotion_sweep emits a recommendation only on decisive evidence; DONE-success never counts as helped

happy.desc: A capability candidate flows through the existing playbook_outcome_record (structured verdict + concrete exposureMode) and playbook_promotion_sweep emits an idempotent promotion recommendation when decisiveSamples suffice; never auto-activates.

edge.desc: A done-settlement outcome does not count toward helped/decisiveSamples; helped requires exposureMode != none + a structured verdictSource (existing enforcement, asserted for capability candidates).

adversarial.desc: No path promotes a capability candidate to active without concrete exposure + structured verdict; the invariant is asserted, not weakened.

items.title: Validation: build + new smokes + lattice validate green; live backfill idempotency proof
items.context: tsc clean; new smokes green; lattice validate pass. Prove the LIVE B-785e backfill is idempotent: re-run is a no-op, no duplicate candidate, PBP-882 stays status=candidate with usage.surfacedCount unchanged, and no helped outcome is produced.
items.userSees: Project validation commands passed; live B-785e backfill idempotency proof green

happy.desc: tsc clean; the three new smokes green; lattice validate --json status=pass with the new smokes in the suite.

edge.desc: The live B-785e backfill is proven idempotent (re-run no-op, PBP-882 stays status=candidate, usage.surfacedCount unchanged, no helped outcome).

adversarial.desc: No unrelated smoke in the curated validate suite regresses.
